title: AppReleaseManifest
description: Contract app-updater/1 (v1.0.0): release manifest stored at <appId>/version.json in R2 and returned by GET /api/v1/update/:appId.

project.description: Workspace project name in C:\antigravity (e.g. PikminFilter, Switchboard).

versionCode.description: Monotonically increasing build integer used for update comparisons.

minRequiredVersionCode.description: If installed versionCode < minRequiredVersionCode, the update dialog is mandatory.

releaseDate.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the release was published.

releaseNotes.description: Plain text or bullet list of changes shown in the update prompt dialog.

apkKey.description: Object key in the R2 bucket for the primary Android APK.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 digest of the APK file.

fileSize.description: Size of the APK file in bytes.

downloadUrl.description: Short-lived HMAC-signed download URL injected by the Cloudflare Worker on GET /api/v1/update/:appId.

artifacts.description: Optional per-target artifact map (e.g. android-arm64, windows-x64) for future multi-ABI or desktop updates.
